claim.quote: Using the HERA-B detector, the b-bbar production cross section has been measured in 920 GeV proton collisions on carbon and titanium targets.

key_value_text.quote: the combined analysis yields the cross section $\sigma(b \bar b) = 32 ^{+14}_{-12} (stat) ^{+6}_{-7} (sys) nb/nucleon$

name: HERA-B b-bbar production cross section in 920 GeV proton-nucleus collisions

summary.plain: From a short commissioning-period run in 2000, HERA-B measured how often a 920 GeV proton striking carbon or titanium produces a pair of bottom quarks, tagging them through J/psi mesons decaying away from the target.
summary.technical: b-bbar production cross section from inclusive b -> J/psi X decays tagged by the longitudinal separation of the J/psi -> l+l- vertex, in both e+e- and mu+mu- channels: sigma(b-bbar) = 32 +14 -12 (stat) +6 -7 (sys) nb/nucleon.

title: Measurement of the b-bbar production cross section in 920 GeV fixed-target proton-nucleus collisions
why_it_matters: The b-bbar cross section at fixed-target energies was poorly known and sets the expected B yield of such experiments.
